#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure: ΔMH distribution with ETS A/B/C classification regions."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Serif',
    'font.size': 7,
    'axes.titlesize': 7.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 7,
    'xtick.labelsize': 6,
    'ytick.labelsize': 6,
    'legend.fontsize': 6,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

DATA_PATH = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520_2/projects/irt_equated_bench_regen/artifacts/plan_001_real_data_dif_mmlu/data/dif_results_temporal.csv'
OUT_DIR = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520_2/projects/irt_equated_bench_regen/figures/paper'

df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
delta = df['delta_mh'].dropna().values

COL_A = '#4DAF4A'
COL_B = '#FF7F00'
COL_C = '#E41A1C'
COL_HIST = '#555555'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.25, 1.85))

bins = np.linspace(-8, 8, 81)
n, bin_edges, patches = ax.hist(delta, bins=bins, color=COL_HIST, alpha=0.75,
                                 edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3)

for patch, left, right in zip(patches, bin_edges[:-1], bin_edges[1:]):
    center = (left + right) / 2
    if abs(center) < 1.0:
        patch.set_facecolor(COL_A)
        patch.set_alpha(0.8)
    elif abs(center) < 1.5:
        patch.set_facecolor(COL_B)
        patch.set_alpha(0.8)
    else:
        patch.set_facecolor(COL_C)
        patch.set_alpha(0.8)

ymax = ax.get_ylim()[1]

for thresh in [-1.5, -1.0, 1.0, 1.5]:
    ls = '--' if abs(thresh) == 1.5 else ':'
    ax.axvline(thresh, color='#333333', linestyle=ls, linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.7)

ax.text(0, ymax * 0.92, 'A', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_A, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(1.25, ymax * 0.92, 'B', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_B, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(-1.25, ymax * 0.92, 'B', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_B, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(3.5, ymax * 0.92, 'C', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_C, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(-3.5, ymax * 0.92, 'C', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_C, alpha=0.9)

n_total = len(delta)
n_a = np.sum(df['ets_class'] == 'A')
n_b = np.sum(df['ets_class'] == 'B')
n_c = np.sum(df['ets_class'] == 'C')
pct_a = 100 * n_a / n_total
pct_b = 100 * n_b / n_total
pct_c = 100 * n_c / n_total

patch_a = mpatches.Patch(color=COL_A, alpha=0.8, label=f'A: {pct_a:.1f}%')
patch_b = mpatches.Patch(color=COL_B, alpha=0.8, label=f'B: {pct_b:.1f}%')
patch_c = mpatches.Patch(color=COL_C, alpha=0.8, label=f'C: {pct_c:.1f}%')
ax.legend(handles=[patch_a, patch_b, patch_c], loc='upper right',
          frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc',
          handlelength=1.0, handletextpad=0.4, borderpad=0.3)

ax.set_xlabel(r'$\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}}$')
ax.set_ylabel('Number of items')
ax.set_xlim(-8, 8)

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
plt.savefig(f'{OUT_DIR}/fig_ets_distribution.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{OUT_DIR}/fig_ets_distribution.png')
print(f'A: {n_a} ({pct_a:.1f}%), B: {n_b} ({pct_b:.1f}%), C: {n_c} ({pct_c:.1f}%)')
print(f'Total: {n_total}')
print('Saved to fig_ets_distribution.pdf')
